title: Capture inspector
blurb: Matrix stage mixing open, closed, nested, and out-of-scope shadow roots across document and element scopes, comparing expected participation against real captured names.
question: Which combinations of shadow root visibility (open, closed, nested, outside-scope) and transition scope (document vs element) actually capture view-transition-name and view-transition-class?
result: Participation requires both flat-tree descent under the scope element and explicit listing of the declaring tree root; nested inner roots and out-of-scope hosts follow exact tree-scope filtering (not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 / Chromium 157 (flag inactive); not verified in Chrome 160
